name: 3-phase Marching Tetrahedra
definition: An algorithm to extract isosurfaces from tetrahedral meshes on GPU that avoids sparse output arrays by using a prefix sum to determine output offsets, allowing separate handling of cells generating 1 vs 2 triangles.
summary: 3-phase Marching Tetrahedra is a GPU algorithm that extracts isosurfaces from tetrahedral meshes using a prefix sum to avoid sparse output arrays and separate handling of cells generating one versus two triangles.
